author: Henry Daniel Mosquera
name: SdkmanInstall
description: Install Java, Gradle, Maven, Kotlin... with SDKMAN! and make them available to the following steps
helpMarkDown: Installs the listed SDKMAN candidates and exports `<CANDIDATE>_HOME` (e.g. `JAVA_HOME`) and the PATH. The first version listed for each candidate is the active one.

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.label: Candidates
inputs.helpMarkDown: One per line: `<candidate> [<version>]`, e.g. `java 21.0.5-tem`, `gradle 8.11`, `maven`. Without a version, SDKMAN's default is used. List a candidate several times to install several versions; the first one is active. `#` starts a comment.

inputs.name: autoInstallSdkman
inputs.label: Install SDKMAN if missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: Installs SDKMAN when it is not on the agent. When off, the task fails if SDKMAN is missing (use SdkmanSetup first).

inputs.name: setHomeVariables
inputs.label: Set <CANDIDATE>_HOME variables
inputs.helpMarkDown: Exports `JAVA_HOME`, `GRADLE_HOME`, `MAVEN_HOME`... for the active version of each candidate.

inputs.name: addToPath
inputs.label: Add to PATH
inputs.helpMarkDown: Prepends the `bin` folder of the active version of each candidate to the PATH.

inputs.name: sdkmanDir
inputs.label: SDKMAN directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where SDKMAN lives (`SDKMAN_DIR`). Empty = the `SDKMAN_DIR` already set by an earlier step, an existing `~/.sdkman`, or `<Agent.ToolsDirectory>/sdkman`.

inputs.name: installUrl
inputs.label: Installer URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Official installer, or an internal mirror for agents without internet access. Keep `rcupdate=false` so the agent's `~/.bashrc` is not modified.

inputs.name: candidatesApi
inputs.label: Candidates API
inputs.helpMarkDown: Overrides `SDKMAN_CANDIDATES_API` (default `https://api.sdkman.io/2`), for a mirror of the SDKMAN API.

inputs.name: bashPath
inputs.label: bash path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a bash 4+ executable. Empty = auto-detect (Homebrew bash on macOS, Git Bash on Windows).

outputVariables.name: sdkmanInstalled
outputVariables.description: JSON list of {candidate, version, home, installedNow, active}
